answer: For a tundra raven census, I propose a nonrefundable $8 monthly fee per voting key. A payment registrar signs key/month/transaction receipts only for settled payments. Public mirror nodes check signatures, key, month and transaction uniqueness. One payment serves one key-month: n active keys cost $8n monthly. Missing or invalid receipts mean no vote that month. This trusts the registrar and payment finality; chargebacks or collusion can erase the cost. Wealthy attackers can still buy many identities, and poor users may be excluded.
